div.head: Northu 42
div.ab: Gif preost forhele, hwæt on his scriftscire betweox mannum to unrihte rixige, gebete þæt.
Gif preost forhele hwæt on his scriftscire betweox mannum to unrihte rixige, gebete þæt.
Wenn ein Priester verhehlt, was in seinem Pfarrsprengel unter den Leuten unrechtmässig vorherrscht, büsse er das.
If a priest conceals what wrongfully prevails among the people in his parish, let him atone for it.
If a priest conceals what wrong is rife among men in his parish, he is to compensate for it.
If a priest conceals what injustice reigns among the people of his parish, he is to atone for that.
div.note: Thorpe misreads ‘rixigen’ and unnecessarily emends to ‘-gende’. Liebermann compares Canons of Edgar 5 f.

note.seg: rixigen liest falsch und emendirt unnöthig -gende Thorpe
rixigen Thorpe reads wrongly, and unnecessarily emends to -gende
Auf der Synode (s. d. Gl 3ff.; u. 44) muss der Priester es künden, wenn er in seiner Pfarrei einen in Kapitallastern Versündigten kennt; Can. Edg. 5f.
At the synod (see that word in Gl 3ff.; below 44) the priest must make it known if he knows of anyone in his parish who has sinned through capital vices; Can. Edg. 5f.
to mit Dativ adverbial s. o. Wb II 212 Z. 14, ferner to wundre ‘wunderbar’; Toller to I 3 C 2. 5f. j
to with the dative used adverbially, see above Wb II 212 l. 14; also to wundre ‘wonderfully’; Toller to I 3 C 2. 5f. j
ricsian to ‘bewegen zu’ verbinden ohne Beleg Frühere: ‘tending to wrong’ Thorpe; ‘anything that may have force to cause injustice’ Toller 795; ‘zum Unrecht verleitet’ Schmid
Earlier scholars, without any instance, take ricsian to together as ‘move to’: ‘tending to wrong’ Thorpe; ‘anything that may have force to cause injustice’ Toller 795; ‘zum Unrecht verleitet’ Schmid
